note: Prioritized feature list. Loop runs flip 'passes' and add 'notes'; they never delete items. Lower priority number = sooner. Rules (2026-10-19): features must track automatically (no routine manual input), fit a general person's day, and keep the flow natural.

features.title: National Weather Service alerts for your spot (red flag, heat, wind)
features.notes: Built 2026-10-23 (preview). Active NWS alerts for the point (api.weather.gov, no key, CORS), checked with the weather poll about every 10 min; zone duplicates, expired, test and cancel messages dropped; last list kept 1 h on device; a 400/404 (non-US point) stops polling until the location changes. Banner replaces the 'Weather now' label (red + pulse for warnings, yellow for watches/advisories, cyan for statements; time hidden on phone). Pip WEATHER ALERT mood (label = event name, warning sign over his head): watches/advisories called out once a day, warnings stay up and sound the alarm. A warning leads the Brief; Today weather card leads with it. Ask Pip: 'any weather alerts', 'warnings', 'red flag'. Not yet checked against the live feed (the build sandbox could not reach api.weather.gov).

features.notes: Built 2026-10-20 (preview). BILLS chip in the Inbox (not a module: everyone has bills). 45 days of bill/statement/renewal/payment emails (metadata only); due date + amount from subject and preview text; payee = sender domain. Payment email newer than the bill -> PAID; autopay/renewal wording -> AUTOPAY; >7 days past due with no payment email is dropped. Pip BILL DUE (stern, bill over head) once a day when <=3 days; PAID! when a payment email clears one. Today inbox card shows the countdown; Brief tip when there is room. Ask Pip: 'what bills are due'. Only payee->status and nudge dates stored. Not yet checked against real bill emails.

features.title: Packages: delivery status from DELIVERY emails
acceptance: carrier and status parsed from shipping emails (Amazon, UPS, USPS, FedEx)

features.notes: Built 2026-10-21 (preview). PACKAGES chip in the Inbox (not a module). 21 days of order/shipping/delivery emails (metadata + preview text only). Emails joined by order number, tracking number, quoted item name or thread; newest status wins, a delivery email always wins. Statuses ORDERED, SHIPPED (with ETA from 'arriving Friday', 'estimated delivery Oct 27', 'scheduled for delivery Thursday'), TODAY (out for delivery), DELAYED, DELIVERED (kept 3 days). Carrier emails are named for the store ('Shipment from REI'); UPS/USPS/FedEx tracking links. Pip: DELIVERY DAY mood holding a box, RUNNING LATE, DELIVERED! cheer; a small box by his side all delivery day. Today inbox card shows package day; Brief tip when there is room; read-aloud always. Ask Pip: 'where are my packages'. Polls every 10 min on delivery day, else 30. Stored on device: hashed package ids -> status and nudge dates only. Food-delivery senders skipped. Not yet checked against real shipping emails.

features.title: Nearby earthquakes (USGS feed), Pip reacts to M3+ within 100 mi
features.notes: Built 2026-10-24 (preview). USGS FDSN query (no key, worldwide): M2.5+ within 300 km over the last day, every 5 min while open (also rides the weather poll). Pip shakes (EARTHQUAKE) once per fresh quake (<2 h) M3+ within 100 mi; BIG QUAKE alarm for M5+ within 100 mi or M6+. Banner in the weather label spot (weather alerts win), Brief tip, Ask Pip 'any earthquakes' / 'was that an earthquake'. Not a module: it stays silent unless a quake is near, so it adds nothing to the screen elsewhere. Not tried against the live feed from the build sandbox.
